verdict.rationale: AvaTax is a SaaS tax platform with AI features (AI-powered tax code recommendations and AI-assisted analysis), so a data-training opt-out is a fair question for it. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents any control, policy, or setting that stops customer data from being used to train AI models.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
